title: Initial computation window
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with a positive number of work tapes, and let $x$ be an input word. At time $0$, the work-tape heads lie in the integer interval $[0,1)$, every work-tape cell outside this interval is blank, and the cell in the interval is visited by some work-tape head by time $0$. The interval has positive width at most $2\cdot 0+1$, and every work-tape head at every time $u\le 0$ lies in $[0,1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ has a positive number of work tapes.
